findings: Resolution logic lives once in anvil/config.py (resolve_station_timeout, effective_executor_timeout); the wrapper and executor both import it, so the dependency points from edges to core and there is one source of truth for ceiling and defaults.

Configuration follows the existing pattern: anvil.yaml value handed to the wrapper through the environment by the executor, with ANVIL_STATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS winning. Bad values are validated at executor construction (fail closed), and the ceiling clamp is announced with the ceiling named.

Minor: PRODUCING_STATIONS in anvil/config.py duplicates WRITE_STATIONS in tools/claude_station.py. The duplication is flagged with a SYNC comment and covered by an agreement test, so it is acceptable, but a single shared definition would be cleaner.

Decision record brain/decisions/0011-station-timeout.md exists, and docs/EXECUTION.md describes the configurable behaviour. No protected pipeline files or anvil.json were touched, and no new dependency was added.
